title: AUTHORIZE the Chief Executive Officer to: A. FIND the procurement of Near-Zero Natural Gas-Fueled Engines under Public Utilities Code (PUC) Section 130237,…
text:
[Metro Board file 2026-0644, Contract]
[OPERATIONS, SAFETY, AND CUSTOMER EXPERIENCE COMMITTEE MADE THE FOLLOWING RECOMMENDATION (5-0):]
AUTHORIZE the Chief Executive Officer to:

A.	FIND the procurement of Near-Zero Natural Gas-Fueled Engines under Public Utilities Code (PUC) Section 130237, as an Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) item, constitutes a single-source procurement method for the purpose of duplicating equipment already in use; and

B.	AWARD a single-source, five-year, Indefinite Delivery, Indefinite Quantity Contract No. MA139582000 to Cummins Sales and Service (Cummins) for 680 engines to replace engines on Metro buses. The five-year contract is for a total Not-To-Exceed (NTE) contract amount of $70,990,755.60, inclusive of sales tax; subject to the resolution of any properly submitted protest(s), if any.

(REQUIRES TWO-THIRDS VOTE OF THE FULL BOARD)
summary: Metro would award Cummins Sales and Service a five-year contract with a not-to-exceed value of $70.99 million to supply 680 near-zero natural gas engines for replacing engines on Metro buses, sole-sourced as an original equipment manufacturer item.
